theorem normalClosure_family_containment_iff {G : Type*} [Group G] {ι : Type*} (S T : Set G) (N : ι → Subgroup G) (hnormal : ∀ i, (N i).Normal) (hST : S ⊆ (Subgroup.normalClosure T : Set G)) (hTS : T ⊆ (Subgroup.normalClosure S : Set G)) : (∀ i, Subgroup.normalClosure S ≤ N i) ↔ (∀ i, Subgroup.normalClosure T ≤ N i) := by
  have help (A B : Set G) (hAB : A ⊆ (Subgroup.normalClosure B : Set G)) (h : ∀ i, Subgroup.normalClosure B ≤ N i) : ∀ i, Subgroup.normalClosure A ≤ N i := by
    intro i
    haveI : (N i).Normal := hnormal i
    apply Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
    intro x hx
    exact h i (hAB hx)
  exact ⟨help T S hTS, help S T hST⟩

  have : normalClosure T ≤ normalClosure S

  apply normalClosure_le_normal
  exact hST
